payment.title: Payment
payment.stripe_instructions: Click the button below to complete your payment securely via Stripe.
payment.failure.refunded: Your payment has been automatically refunded.
payment.failure.contact_support: Please contact support for a refund.
payment.success.thank_you: Thank you for your payment. Your ticket has been confirmed.
payment.success.email_notice: Your ticket will be sent from {fromEmail} — please check your Junk/Spam folder.
payment.cancel.title: Payment Cancelled
payment.cancel.heading: Payment Cancelled
payment.cancel.message: Your payment was cancelled. Your ticket reservation has been removed.
payment.pending.title: Payment not confirmed yet
payment.pending.heading: Payment not confirmed yet
payment.pending.message: We have not received your payment yet. If you have paid, your ticket will be sent to you by email. This can take a few minutes.
payment.pending.auto_check: This page will keep checking for you.
payment.error.title: Payment Error
payment.error.heading: Payment Error
payment.error.refunded: We could not read this payment, so we did not make a booking. We have sent your money back. It can take a few days to reach your account. Please do not pay again.
payment.error.provider_not_configured: Online payment is not set up on this site yet. Please contact the organiser.
payment.error.session_not_found: We could not find this payment session.
payment.error.session_not_recognized: We could not confirm that this payment belongs to this site. Please contact support.
payment.error.listing_not_found: We could not find the tickets you were booking.
payment.error.verification_failed: We could not confirm your payment. Please contact support.
payment.staff.heading: Staff diagnostics
payment.staff.reasons_heading: Known reasons a payment can sit unconfirmed:
payment.staff.reason_abandoned: The card step was never finished. For example, the 3-D Secure window was closed.
payment.staff.reason_delay: The provider has not told us yet. This can be a short delay or a provider problem.
payment.staff.reason_webhook: The webhook address is not configured for this site, so finished payments never reach us.
payment.staff.reason_account: The provider account does not match this site. A checkout this site created can then read as not ours.
payment.popup.title: Complete Payment
payment.popup.instructions: Payment is processed in a new window.
payment.popup.waiting: Completing payment in the other window...
payment.success.title: Order Successful
payment.success.heading: Thank you for your order.
